# Flat File Schema Wizard
## Table of Contents
1. [Overview](#overview)
2. [Fixed Length](#fixed-length)
3. [Delimited](#delimited)



## Overview
* Get the instance file ready and give the schema proper root record name and namespace
* Always "By delimiter symbol" for the first layer by file's newline symbol(s)
* Give each record proper name and type. Latter records can be ignored if it's repeating record.
------------------------------------------------------------
* Base on the content, choose either
  * "By delimiter symbol" for csv 
  * "By relative positions" for fixed length
* If a record has identifier, please tick and give it a tag
  * Some records could have H/Header or D/Detail at the beginning
* Delimit subsequent elements or records
  * If the file has 3rd layer and onward, select data manually to include desired content
* Name each element and leave "Data Type" as string (as string has no validation)
* Repeat until all records are filled with proper elements
------------------------------------------------------------
* Once finished, click on `<Schema>` and set the followings to Yes
  * Allow Early Termination
  * Allow Message Breakup At Infix Root (if elements are delimited)
  * Early Terminate Optional Fields
* If it's inbound, set "Child Delimiter" to 0x0A on the root (In BizTalk, 0x0D should be removed from pipeline to allow both CRLF and LF only)
* If elements are delimited (csv, not fixed), set "Child Order" to Infix for all records
* Update "Max Occurs" accordingly and "Min Occurs" to 0 if feasible for all records
* Add additional element to the end of each record in case client adds new field(s) in the future
* Set "Min Occurs" to 0 for all elements
* If it's csv, set "Wrap Character Type" to Character to escape commas with wrap character
* If values are right justified, set Justification to Right or normalize-space() in XSLT
* &#x1F6a9;**ALWAYS test your schema in Visual Studio and BizTalk with different scenarios to make sure it works with the best compatibility and no errors in eHub**
  * Additional elements/records
  * Missing elements/records
  * CRLF and LF only
  * Change "Parser Optimization" to Compliexity if it fits (and increase "Lookahead Depth" if default depth is not enough)
